 Sutton's predictions: Ipswich v Bournemouth 
 Published 3 hours ago 
 Bournemouth have turned into one of the Premier League's form teams. 
 I thought they would run out of steam against Leeds United last week but I was wrong, and they have shown they have got a bit of depth in their squad.
 I've been surprised by Ipswich too, and they were unlucky not to beat Hull City last time out. The Tractor Boys have got a bit of spirit about them, which makes me think they will get something from this game.
 Bournemouth are a front-foot team under Marco Rose, who is a very attack-minded manager, but Ipswich will have a go too. I can see them getting a point.
 Sutton's prediction: 1-1
